<th class="th" colspan="1">6 Months Ended</th>

<tr><th class="th"><div>Jun. 30, 2026</div></th></tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsAbstract', window );"><strong>Organization, Consolidation and Presentation of Financial Statements [Abstract]</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_NatureOfOperations', window );">Description of the Business</a></td>
<td class="text"><p style="font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.1020833333333333;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">1. Description of the Business</span></p><p style="margin-left:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Organization</span></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">First Tracks Biotherapeutics, Inc. (&#8220;First Tracks Biotherapeutics,&#8221; &#8220;we,&#8221; &#8220;us,&#8221; &#8220;our,&#8221; or the &#8220;Company&#8221;) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing antibody therapies that modulate immune pathways implicated in autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Our pipeline includes ANB033, a CD122 antagonist in development for celiac disease and eosinophilic esophagitis; rosnilimab, a pathogenic T cell depleter in development for rheumatoid arthritis; and ANB101, a BDCA2 modulator.</span></p><p style="margin-left:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Separation</span></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Our financial support has been provided primarily by AnaptysBio, Inc. (&#8220;AnaptysBio&#8221;</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">), our former parent company. In September 2025, AnaptysBio announced its intent, as approved by its board of directors on September 29, 2025, to separate our operations from AnaptysBio into a separate, independent, publicly traded company (the &#8220;Spin-Off&#8221;). The Spin-Off was completed on </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">April 20, 2026</span></span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> (the &#8220;Distribution Date&#8221;).</span></p><p style="text-indent:5.84%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Spin-Off was achieved through AnaptysBio&#8217;s pro rata distribution of </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">29,100,902</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> shares of </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">common stock of First Tracks Biotherapeutics to holders of record of AnaptysBio&#8217;s common stock. Each holder of record of AnaptysBio&#8217;s common stock received one share of First Tracks Biotherapeutics&#8217; common stock for every one share of AnaptysBio&#8217;s common stock held on April 6, 2026, the record date for the distribution. On April 20, 2026, First Tracks Biotherapeutics&#8217; shares of common stock began trading on the Nasdaq Stock Market LLC under the ticker symbol &#8220;TRAX.&#8221;</span></p><p style="text-indent:5.84%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">On the Distribution Date, AnaptysBio </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">distributed </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">29,100,902</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> shares of First Tracks Biotherapeutics common stock to its shareholders and the Company completed the previously announced private placement contemplated by that certain purchase agreement (the &#8220;Purchase Agreement&#8221;) by and among the Company, EcoR1 Capital Fund Qualified, L.P. (the &#8220;Selling Stockholder&#8221;) and certain third party investors (collectively, the &#8220;Investors&#8221;), pursuant to which the Company agreed to issue and sell an aggregate of </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">5,791,479</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock (the &#8220;Primary Shares&#8221;), and the Selling Stockholder agreed to sell an aggregate of </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">4,705,575</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock (the &#8220;Secondary Shares&#8221;) that the Selling Stockholder received in the Spin-Off, at a purchase price of $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">13.81</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> per share (the &#8220;Private Placement&#8221;). The aggregate gross proceeds to First Tracks Biotherapeutics from the sale of the Primary Shares were approximately $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">80</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> million, before deducting offering expenses. First Tracks Biotherapeutics did not receive any proceeds from the sale of the Secondary Shares.</span></p><p style="text-indent:5.84%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">In connection with the Spin-Off, we entered into a separation and distribution agreement (the &#8220;Separation and Distribution Agreement&#8221;) with AnaptysBio. The Separation and Distribution Agreement identifies the assets transferred to (including the contracts assigned) or retained by, and the liabilities assumed or retained by each of us, and AnaptysBio. Pursuant to the Separation and Distribution Agreement, on the Distribution Date,</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">100</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> million in cash and cash equivalents was allocated to us from AnaptysBio. Furthermore, all accounts payable and accrued liabilities were assumed by AnaptysBio.</span></p><p style="margin-left:6.667%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Liquidity and Risks</span></p><p style="text-indent:5.84%;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;line-height:1.15;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Going forward, as we continue our expansion, we may seek additional financing and/or strategic investments. However, there can be no assurance that any additional financing or strategic investments will be available to us on acceptable terms, if at all. If events or circumstances occur such that we do not obtain additional funding, we will most likely be required to reduce our plans and/or certain discretionary spending, which could have a material adverse effect on our ability to achieve our intended business objectives. Our management believes our currently available resources will provide sufficient funds to enable us to meet our operating plans for at least the next </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">12</span></span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> months from the issuance of our financial statements. The accompanying financial statements do not include any adjustments that might be necessary if we are unable to continue as a going concern.</span></p><span></span>
</td>
</tr>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for the nature of an entity's business, major products or services, principal markets including location, and the relative importance of its operations in each business and the basis for the determination, including but not limited to, assets, revenues, or earnings. For an entity that has not commenced principal operations, disclosures about the risks and uncertainties related to the activities in which the entity is currently engaged and an understanding of what those activities are being directed toward.</p></div>
